direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; grid rows 48px/52px/1fr/56px, cols 184px/minmax(0,1fr)/360px at 1366x768; FactoryStage >=55vw and >=60vh, EvidenceInspector internal-scroll only, DecisionBar pinned, no page scroll

direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room button; StepRail from single steps array, 9 steps plus completion, 36-40px aria-current buttons, remove dead workspace disclosures; GuideStrip 52px without duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px separating pre-flight nonce/identity route health from investigation evidence task; consent opens on selecting a recovery option; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre, one primary right; skip-to-stage first, then header>rail>guide>SVG nodes>inspector>DecisionBar, arrows in rail/SVG, Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live=polite for results only

Visually and semantically separate ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT nonce/identity status from the distinct Run Sample investigation action and button.
Give the route select a persistent visible label and 40px height; keep Sample offline wording adjacent to the control, not only below it.
Move focus to the investigation result region after running, with aria-live=polite announcing completion only.
Keep typed consent form opened by selecting a recovery option, but show character progress as 0/27 typed rather than only remaining count.
Link Selected path state bidirectionally: selecting a card highlights only its feasible SVG route and vice versa.
Keep Accept disabled until exact phrase matches and explain the disabled reason beside the DecisionBar status.
Preserve PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL on t1-t3; add one-line untracked explanation above the cards so 0 tracked is unmistakably intentional.
Make Decline proposal a secondary text button visually subordinate to Approve Britt's proposal in the DecisionBar.
Show 40+30=70 allocation on the accepted MAT-ALLOY-B route where it splits to JOB-1001 and JOB-1002.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 preview in stoppedRed cross-hatch with PREVIEW - not applied text, distinct from its still-ONLINE inspector status until Apply is pressed.
Add keyboard focus order: machine select, consequence summary, then Apply second shock; announce invalidation consequence before activation.
Reduce duplicated accepted-plan wording between stage title, Britt strip and DecisionBar to one status sentence.
Remove duplication between the top CELL-MILL-2 OFFLINE banner and the dashed summary above the Inspector; retain one state banner inside the stage.
Keep stoppedRed confined to CELL-MILL-2 outline, OFFLINE/STOPPED text and cross-hatch; ensure no route is drawn through it and Split is marked constrained.
Again separate pre-flight route health from the Reinvestigate recovery evidence task with distinct headings, spacing and primary-action grouping.
Make constrained Split card non-selectable with aria-disabled, reason text, and dashed pattern so it cannot open consent.
On selecting the feasible revised option, open its typed consent form and echo plan identifier and exact APPROVE phrase directly above the input.
Show prior acceptance invalidated once in the DecisionBar centre, not repeated in banner, Britt strip and Human Decision heading.

Expand prior blocked tasks by keyboard with Enter/Space and return focus to the disclosure after toggling.
Clarify DecisionBar status as Approved revised plan - replacement tasks await approval, matching the Inspector proposal state.
Remove duplicate Verify ledger primary: keep one primary in DecisionBar and make Inspector Verify/Export actions secondary until their sequence is active.
Sequence Seal encrypted packet, Verify ledger and Export independent checkpoint with numbered states and disable later actions until prerequisites complete.
Prevent Inspector bottom clipping with internal scroll, sticky summary metrics and visible focus on Advanced disclosure.
Replace Review recovery proof primary with a clear completion state or Back to proof action if no further state change occurs; avoid implying another required step.
Keep PACKET SEALED, 18 events and revised plan accepted as one completion sentence in DecisionBar and stage footer.
Ensure completion rail item uses aria-current and check marker plus text, not color alone, while retaining only the header logo placement on this step.
